theorem lg_target {p : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (hr : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * p n) Filter.atTop (nhds r)) : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds (r ^ k / ↑k.factorial)) := by
  induction' k with k IH
  · intro n
    rw [Nat.choose_zero, one_pow, div_one]
    exact (hr (n + 1)).continuous_at (by simp)
  · have h : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * p n) Filter.atTop (nhds r) := hr
    have h' : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds (r ^ k / ↑k.factorial)) :=
      by {
        let f := fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k
        let g := fun n => ↑n * p n
        have hg : Filter.Tendsto g Filter.atTop (nhds r) := h
        have hf : Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds (r ^ k / ↑k.factorial)) :=
          by {
            apply tendsto.prod
            · exact (tendsto.pow hg (by exact Nat.cast_pos k))
            · exact (tendsto.mul_left hg (by exact (tendsto.const_nhds (↑k.factorial) (by exact rfl))))
          }
        exact hf
      }
    exact h'
